{{Short description|Estonian physicist (born 1947)}}
'''Romi Mankin''' (born November 7, 1947) is an Estonian physicist known for his work in the field of [[stochastic processes]]. Currently he holds a post in [[Tallinn University]] as a Professor of Theoretical Physics. He is well published having published many articles in both the Proceedings of the Estonian Academy of Sciences and in the various sections of [[Physical Review]] (typically E but also D).<ref name="aps">{{cite journal | last=Mankin | first=Romi | last2=Ainsaar | first2=Ain | last3=Haljas | first3=Astrid | last4=Reiter | first4=Eerik | title=Trichotomous-noise-induced catastrophic shifts in symbiotic ecosystems | journal=Physical Review E | publisher=American Physical Society (APS) | volume=65 | issue=5 | date=2002-05-14 | issn=1063-651X | doi=10.1103/physreve.65.051108 | article-number=051108}}</ref><ref name="aps2">{{cite journal | last=Mankin | first=Romi | last2=Laas | first2=T õnu | last3=Tammelo | first3=Risto | title=Electromagnetic wave tails on curved spacetime and their observational implications | journal=Physical Review D | publisher=American Physical Society (APS) | volume=62 | issue=4 | date=2000-07-05 | issn=0556-2821 | doi=10.1103/physrevd.62.041501 | page=041501(R)}}</ref> and other major journals.<ref name="iop">{{cite journal | last=Mankin | first=Romi | last2=Tammelo | first2=Risto | last3=Laas | first3=Tõnu | title=Complete algorithms for calculating the higher-order fundamental solutions of wave equations | journal=Classical and Quantum Gravity | publisher=IOP Publishing | volume=16 | issue=4 | date=1999-01-01 | issn=0264-9381 | doi=10.1088/0264-9381/16/4/011 | pages=1215–1225}}</ref>

In 2002 he was awarded the [[Estonian Physical Society]] Annual Award. This was for his contribution to the development of stochastical physics in the area of noise-induced phase transitions and transfer phenomena.<ref>Proceedings of the Estonian Academy of Sciences, Physics and Mathematics Jun 2002 p124</ref><ref>http://www.fyysika.ee/efs/autasud/aastapreemia.html Estonian Physical Society: List of Annual Award Winners (Eesti Füüsika Selts (EFS): Aastapreemia laureaatide nimekiri) (Accessed Jan 2011)</ref>
